message: `aria-live="off"` on the `<span>` inside it sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part with its `status` whose text sits in a `<span aria-live="off">`. Firefox 158 gives the span an accessible of its own and hands the text `container-live="off"` in place of the `polite` the `status` gives (measured on 2026-10-27); NVDA and Orca read no region off a `container-live` but `polite` or `assertive`, so a change of the warning is announced by neither. Point 7 read the part and what stands above it, nothing inside it, and passed it.
